ArbiLive — arbitrage trading bot created by the ua_invest foundation

Supports spot-buy + short, futures + futures, and spot-sell + long.

Main features
9 CORE CAPABILITIES
Realtime & History Data

Realtime and history spreads, fundings and prices.

Proxy Management

Manage and rotate proxies for stable connectivity and exchange interaction.

Multiple Accounts

Work with multiple exchange accounts inside one operational environment.

Balance Synchronization

Automatic balance synchronization across your configured accounts.

Operational Control Panel

Manage leverage, sizing, credentials, and execution settings in a structured workflow.

Cross-device Workflow

Same trading context on desktop and mobile with consistent dark/light theme support.

Notifications

Notifications via Telegram, Pushover, and Web Push.

Multiple Bots Running

Run multiple bots in parallel with isolated operational context.

Fastest Order Execution

Execution path is optimized for the lowest possible placement latency; speed can be as low as 3-4ms.

Supported exchanges
CLOSED BETA ACCESS
How to get access to closed beta

Reminder on how to get access to Arbi Live during the beta testing period.

OPTION 1

Purchase an Arbitrage VIP subscription for 12 months

After that, you will get access to the closed chat with instructions

OPTION 2

If you are a UA_INVEST referral on exchanges and generate stable monthly trading volume.

Terms are individual. For details, contact @dnepryanik.
